comment: Overall impression: IHE International strongly supports the direction of the DPI-H Reference Architecture and welcomes its explicit alignment with IHE specifications and testing. With the revisions recommended, the guidance can go further: it can direct countries not only to use international standards, but also to participate in the international, open, consensus-based processes that close gaps, maintain specifications, and verify interoperability over time.
